paragraphs: I am software developer, registered nurse, 3D modeler, and lifelong learner. I've worked on a great many projects as a developer, and my experience as a pediatric ICU nurse has helped me remain calm, cool, and collected under pressure. While I'm not 100% sure what I want to be when I grow up, I know it will involve code and technology. I live to learn new things, and I hope you reach out to chat!
Notable languages/technologies: TypeScript (React, Angular), C#, Python (software), Python (data science/Databricks), Dart (Flutter), PowerShell, and Rust. I'm also learning Kotlin and Swift!
